Champion of Justice has been tweaked. The Serving Justice buff now also stacks up from Holy Shock, and now lasts for 20 seconds (from 15). The Adorned and Champion of Justice heals can no longer trigger multiple times from the same GCD. The heal from Adorned can now crit and has increased scaling. A new effect has also been added: healing an Adorned target with Holy Shock will consume Adorn to heal up to five nearby low-health allies. With these changes, Champion of Justice should be more well-rounded, being less of an outlier at 25-player raid healing but significantly more versatile and more capable at keeping their groups alive.
Fixed the tooltip of Pious Strikes to clarify it only happens once. In addition, fixed the issue where it could trigger multiple times when triggered by Avenger's Shield.

Crimson Champion now also requires Defensive Stance or Righteous Fury, just like Holy Shield.
